title: Supported source system cup calculus
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site small relative to its universe of ordinary module sheaves, with $\mathcal O$ commutative [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use its derived category, signed cochain total tensor and K-flat derived tensor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Let $S$ be a set with an associative commutative operation $\wedge$. For each $c\in S$ let $P_c$ be a flat degree-zero sheaf [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Suppose specified isomorphisms $\mu_{c,d}:P_c\otimes^LP_d\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{c\wedge d}$ satisfy $\mu_{c\wedge d,e}(\mu_{c,d}\otimes1)=\mu_{c,d\wedge e}(1\otimes\mu_{d,e})$ after reassociation, and $\mu_{d,c}\sigma=\mu_{c,d}$ after label interchange. Let $L_r$ ($r\in\mathbf Z$) be flat degree-zero invertible sheaves, with associative isomorphisms $h_{r,s}:L_r\otimes^LL_s\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{r+s}$ satisfying $h_{s,r}\sigma=h_{r,s}$.

Use $B_{a,b}$ and the fixed shift comparison $t_{a,b}$ of [lem-pur-shifted-tensor-morphism-calculus]. For $f:P_c\to L_r[a]$ and $g:P_d\to L_s[b]$, define
$$f\star g=h_{r,s}[a+b]B_{a,b}(f,g)\mu_{c,d}^{-1}:P_{c\wedge d}\to L_{r+s}[a+b].$$
Then $\star$ is additive in each variable, associative, and $f\star g=(-1)^{ab}g\star f$ after the specified label and weight identifications, for arbitrary integer degrees and weights.

Let $u$ be a morphism to a second such ringed topos with exact module pullback $U=u^*$ and its canonical tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Suppose a label map $c\mapsto c'$ preserves $\wedge$ and isomorphisms $b_c:UP_c\cong P'_{c'}$, $\tau_r:UL_r\cong L'_r$ satisfy $b_{c\wedge d}U\mu_{c,d}=\mu'_{c',d'}(b_c\otimes b_d)$ and $\tau_{r+s}Uh_{r,s}=h'_{r,s}(\tau_r\otimes\tau_s)$. Define $U^\# f=\tau_r[a](Uf)b_c^{-1}$ with canonical shift comparisons. Then
$$U^\#(f\star g)=(U^\# f)\star'(U^\# g).$$
This is an equality for the specified tensor comparisons on all derived morphisms, not merely on cohomology classes represented by pure tensors.

proof.text: Apply shiftedTensorMorphismCalculus_local to the flat source sheaves for both additivity equations. Compose the resulting equalities with mu inverse and shifted h, using bilinearity of composition. Prove naturality of B under precomposition by bifunctoriality, and under shifted postcomposition by naturality of shiftedTensorCanonicalComparison. These identities hold for all derived objects; tensor closure of degree-zero sources is unnecessary.

source.place: Tags 0FPL/0FPM; elementary naturality and additivity assembly from the cited normalized tensor calculus.

proof.text: Use the two B naturality identities to expand both nested cups. Precompose with the isomorphism tensor(mu(c,d),1) followed by mu(c*d,e), and cancel the source inverses. The source associativity hypothesis changes the right source composite to the canonical derived associator followed by tensor(1,mu(d,e)); cancel its inverse. Apply the associativity clause of shiftedTensorMorphismCalculus_local to the three original flat sources. Commute degree transports past shifted coefficient maps by equality induction. Finally apply the shift functor to h_assoc, postcomposed by the inverse weight transport; the composite degree and weight transport is exactly the displayed conclusion.

source.place: Tag 0FPL, lemma-cup-product-associative; explicit coefficient/source-system assembly of the shifted-Hom associativity identity.

proof.text: Precompose the desired symmetry identity with mu(c,d). Derive sigma(Pc,Pd)=mu(c,d) followed by the label transport and mu(d,c) inverse from mu_comm. Rewrite h_comm under the shift functor and apply the symmetry clause of shiftedTensorMorphismCalculus_local. Bilinearity moves the Koszul integer scalar through composition. Equality induction commutes the degree interchange past shifted h; functoriality identifies the remaining weight and degree transports.

source.place: Tag 0FPM, lemma-cup-product-commutative; explicit graded symmetry assembly, using the signed-Hom identity instead of the omitted relative-cup proof.

proof.text: Extract the two-shift coherence equation from shiftedTensorMorphismCalculus. Expand B, use that coherence and naturality of the exact tensor comparison to obtain its pullback equation on arbitrary derived sources. Precompose the required cup identity by U(mu(c,d)) followed by the source pullback comparison. Expand the cup and its pullback, cancel the source inverses, and rewrite hb. Naturality of the shift comparison moves U(h) past it; h_tau rewrites the coefficient composite. Apply the B pullback equation. The precomposition naturality of B moves the two source comparisons through B and cancels their inverses. Postcomposition naturality moves the two coefficient comparisons through B, leaving exactly the pulled-back cup.
